text:
I rewrote the task's outcome as a short ticked checklist with links, because the text check flagged it as a 62-word paragraph. The text check now comes back clean, and I logged one "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`.

I did not run the screenshot look. `layout-check` skipped it because the landing names no site pages, so the status/asked/delivered test is unchecked. The task folder also has no `requirements.md`, so I couldn't match the checklist against the owner's original asks. It ticks the three finished parts and leaves the Lew42 rename, merges and tosses unticked, waiting on the owner's keep list.
